settings.heading: Let’s Put Something Great on Your Shelves
settings.body:
Interested in carrying Varty? Tell us about your store and we’ll be in touch within 3 business days.

We partner with independent grocers, health food stores, pharmacies, gyms, wellness spaces, and retailers who care about what goes on their shelves. If your customers are looking for a clean, organic oat beverage made with 3–4 simple ingredients, we’d love to hear from you.
